modify.note: reportWrongAssignment now saves the report (with the reporter, team and, when the booking came through a routing form, that form) as PENDING and returns the new report's id. A second report for the same booking is rejected with BAD_REQUEST and the translated wrong_assignment_already_reported message, including when two submissions race. A new hasWrongAssignmentReport query tells whether a booking already has a report, and throws UNAUTHORIZED if the user cannot access that booking.
Bookings gain a link to their wrong assignment reports, and the BookingRepository lookup the report handler uses also returns the id of the routing form the booking was routed from.

The Report wrong assignment dialog checks whether the booking already has a report; if so it shows a warning and disables Submit. Clearing the team member selection must reset the form value to empty.
The bookings UI also calls viewer.bookings.hasWrongAssignmentReport when the wrong assignment dialog opens.

add_nodes.label: WrongAssignmentReport model
add_nodes.summary: Persisted wrong assignment reports, at most one per booking.
add_nodes.description: New table for reports that a booking was assigned to the wrong person, with a review status (PENDING, REVIEWED, RESOLVED, DISMISSED). Booking uid is unique. Linked to the booking, the reporting user, the team and the routing form; deleting the reporter or the team keeps the report and clears the link. Accessed through WrongAssignmentReportRepository.
add_nodes.note: Store each wrong assignment report so it can be reviewed later, with a migration that creates a unique index on booking uid. New reports start as PENDING.
